credit.realms: Dependencies and autonomous territories with their own government, outside their sovereign state's own territory (Greenland, the Faroe Islands, Hong Kong, Macau, Puerto Rico, the Crown dependencies, the British, French, Dutch, US, New Zealand and Australian overseas territories), which Cliopatria draws as their sovereign state or leaves out
credit.title: Admin 0 – Countries, 1:10m
credit.author: Natural Earth
credit.changes: Simplified; each feature's ClipOutline, its outline widened at sea (by 0.3°, or more where the sovereign state is far), takes the slivers Cliopatria's coastline leaves of the sovereign state; islands under 20 km² widened by about 1 km so they show; Tokelau taken from New Zealand's feature, and Christmas Island and the Cocos (Keeling) Islands from the Indian Ocean Territories. Each feature's Claim says why the territory is drawn on its own in its years, and PartOf names its sovereign state
